notes: Trained on batch-corrected acoustic features (Part 4.2). If deploying on audio from a new, unseen recording batch, apply the same per-batch z-score correction before scoring; for single-session field deployment with no batch context, raw features are acceptable. Predictions within the review_band should be routed to manual inspection rather than auto-classified — see Part 5.5.
